title: Amazon’s new Kindle Colorsoft is a premium e-reader with a premium price
snippet: The latest model is lighter and thinner than its predecessor and features an edge-to-edge display. But if you already own the first-generation Colorsoft, there’s little reason to upgrade.

title: Jensen Huang’s departure blasts big hole in AI startup funding, VCs and founders say
snippet: Nvidia poured tens of billions into AI startups under Huang. Without him at the helm, founders and VCs are bracing for smaller checks and lower valuations.
